reviews.text: Jenn was absolutely incredible with our dog Wren! Wren has transformed since starting training 6 weeks ago and we are incredibly grateful. Jenn is a great teacher not only for dogs but owners as well. We received notes/feedback after each session from her which really helped us keep her on track. I highly recommend Back to Basics dog training!

Absolutely loved our private training sessions with Jenn!!! We learned so much, and really got what we wanted from it, absolutely worth it and would highly recommend it! Jenn was also a huge pleasure to work with; very knowledgable, friendly, and patient. She sent us tons of information which helped us even after our training sessions ended and checked in with us during the weeks, which made us feel so supported throughout this program!

Really gonna miss these sessions, and can't recommend Jenn enough!
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Rick! ⭐ We truly appreciate your support and are so grateful you trust us and Coach Connor with your pup. We look forward to seeing you both again soon! 🐾 …
Wen very kindly took the time to answer my questions regarding potty training my new dog. She was professional, thorough, and provided great tips. I would recommend her training service!

After rescuing a puppy with a very spicy attitude we weren’t sure what to do. He was all over the place, barking and charging every dog he saw on walks, biting too hard when he was playing, and terrorizing our cats.

Then Jenn came to the rescue.

As an example, after a single session working with him outside he has been a dream on walks ever since.

After the entire 6 weeks of classes he’s been more focused, well behaved, and is even playing with the cats. Jenn was patient working with Kevin, pivoted as needed to make sure not only Kevin was setup for success but also we were too, and gave us the tools to keep him learning well into the future. We are extremely grateful for her help and it’s been so rewarding watching our dog grow through the experience.

My 3-year-old reactive dachshund, Wrigley, and I completed the 5-week Behavior Modification class with Wen, and I honestly can’t recommend her enough. Not only has Wrigley’s behavior improved, but the class strengthened our bond and helped him learn to trust and listen to me.

The biggest difference I’ve noticed is when we’re out at events or around other dogs. Instead of immediately reacting, he now takes the time to observe, stay calm, and listen. Seeing that progress has been amazing.

Wen is incredibly patient, hands-on, and supportive. She gave us homework each week so we could keep practicing, and she regularly checked in with us by text to see how things were going. I genuinely looked forward to every class because we could see real improvement each week, and we had so much fun doing it.

Thank you, Wen, for helping Wrigley and me so much!

We had the best experience with Wen during our 6-week advanced obedience course! Milo is a rescue who struggled with excitement reactivity on walks and stranger danger at home, and the transformation we’ve seen in just six weeks has been incredible.

Wen gave us the tools and confidence to actually enjoy walks again without lunging at other dogs, and she taught us effective, structured introductions for when new people come over. Milo has gained so much confidence, and it’s been amazing to watch his progress week after week.

We’re excited to continue practicing everything we learned and even plan to enroll him in daycare in the future, something we never would have felt comfortable doing before. Thank you, Wen, for your patience, knowledge, and genuine care for Milo. We are so grateful for everything you’ve done for our family!

Amazing training and service that has paid off so well. Was nervous about our dog/car getting along and with Wen's help, things couldn’t have been better. The lessons our dog has learned has stuck around and she keeps getting better with the at home teaching lessons they have provided. Truly appreciate the help and service.

Wen and Jenn at Back to Basics were wonderful to work with. We came into our private training lessons with Jenn overwhelmed with our reactive and highly distractible Pyrenees Bobbi. Our previous training gave us a foundation for basics but was not helping us or Bobbi with her reactivity and excitement around other dogs. Jenn patiently worked with us and Bobbi and since the completion of our training Bobbi has steadily improved her calmness around other dogs and attentiveness towards us on walks. Months ago we couldn't even think about walking past another dog on the same sidewalk because Bobbi would jump at any dog she saw, not to be aggressive, but to play. She would lock onto dogs across the street and lay down which was frustrating when we were trying to walk her on a time crunch, she pulled like a freight train even with corrective harnesses, and would completely ignore us. Jenn gave us the tools to manage these issues and now we don't dread walks anymore. She is much more attentive to us, and mostly ignores dogs that are across the street or farther away, which is insane considering she used to lay down for dogs a block away from us. Jenn gave us some redirection tools that allow us to easily re-route her now when we see potential issues with other dogs arise, and we have also gotten her pulling much more under control. If Jenn and Wen were able to help us and our crazy pup, I'm confident they can help you as well!

We worked with Jenn. She was very patient with us and our pup. She gave us various tips and tricks to help our 7 month old Shepard mix socialize, manage his reactivity and bond with us. We recommend Back to Basics and Jenn!

We chose to do daycare and train option because our puppy Charlie was a pretty nervous guy so this was a good compromise giving him the opportunity to have plenty of training while still coming home to us after work- it also gave us the opportunity for socialization. Connor did a great job with Charlie and adjusted to how our nervous boy was feeling on a given day or setting. He gained more confidence and I can now walk him without being dragged down the street :) Charlie learned a lot of things that really help in the day to day like stay and door manners and his recall is great which is really helpful especially at 7 months and full of energy. Aside from videos we were able to ask a lot of questions and adjust along the way and Connor also helped us break some of Charlie’s bad habits we were struggling with. I looked into a few options for training and Back to Basics was absolutely the right call!

We rescued our puppy before having our third baby and we’re looking to get our puppy trained asap! I reached out to a few training places and then came across Wen at Back to Basics. Just speaking to Wen on the phone, I immediately felt comfortable and she had so much knowledge! We did in home training and then sent her for 10 day training. Our puppy Cleo came out a different puppy and listens to all her commands! She also helped get her on a crate schedule and she has all her naps and sleeps over night in her crate. Wen is such a great trainer and became friend to us. We love you Wen!

Connor and the Posh Pet team did an amazing job with our dog. We adopted a stray pitbull with little training and he taught him how to sit stay and leave toys and drastically improved his resource guarding and aggression. The best part was they taught us how to continue the training and help in prove habits at home. Connor came over and helped us to teach good habits when walking on the leash and even how to sit and stay when guests knock. I would highly recommend working with them for training techniques!

My wife and I took our 3 month old puppy to Posh Pet for Back to the Basics Training.  It was 2 weeks of training and boarding.  Connor was our pup’s trainer and we can’t speak highly enough of the work Connor performed.  He taught our pup several commands to help us control his behavior.  He was extremely professional, trained us on how to emphasize the commands, documented and communicated the process the entire time they had him, and has made himself available for any follow up questions.

Furthermore, he scheduled an in home follow up appointment a few weeks later to ensure there were no questions, monitor his progress, and add home specific tips.  Lastly, you can tell that Connor genuinely cares about our pet and his profession.  Thank you again Back to the Basics and Connor!

MJ worked with our very high energy Bernedoodle. He is still very much a puppy but over 90 pounds. 😑 Was extremely grateful for her guidance and support. You get weekly assignments to work on for reinforcement. Our dog loved her. 🥰
Definitely recommend her and will do more advanced training come summer. …

After we adopted our puppy Murphy, we quickly realized he was going to be a big guy who needed proper training to ensure we could handle him. Wen Tze responded right away and helped us choose the two-week board and train program (Puppy Bootcamp) to give all of us the best start.

Before starting his official training, Murphy attended daycare several times at Posh Pet Club, and he absolutely loves it there! He comes home happy, exhausted, and ready for dinner. It’s such a wonderful environment for him to socialize with other dogs and interact with humans who clearly have experience and a genuine love for animals.

Leading up to the board and train, Connor, Murphy’s trainer, checked in to understand our priorities and made himself available to answer questions. During the training, he organized a Google Drive and shared daily videos that were incredibly helpful. They not only showed Murphy’s progress but explained why each skill matters and how we can reinforce the training moving forward. Murphy learned to focus, sit, stay, come, walk politely through doors, walk on a leash, recall, stop jumping on people, and so much more. One thing I learned through this process is that in order to be a great dog trainer, you also need to be a strong teacher for people. Connor is an expert at both and explained everything in a way that felt doable and not overwhelming.

Posh Pet Club also sent daily updates and photos of Murphy enjoying playtime, which eased my nerves about leaving him for two weeks.

His return home was seamless. Being such a young dog, I worried he might forget us, but he settled right back in without any issues. We practice a little every day, and he has become such a cool, calm, confident dog. I’m amazed by how well-behaved he is when new people arrive at our house or when he encounters other dogs on walks.

Back to Basics Dog Training and Posh Pet Club has been wonderful for us. Murphy is thriving, and we feel confident thanks to their expertise and care. I highly recommend both for anyone looking for exceptional training and a safe, fun daycare/boarding experience!

We had a great experience with Back to Basics training. We adopted a puppy and wanted our family to work with a trainer to help with his behavior, listening, walks, etc. It was so helpful for all of us and our pup! Thank you Wen Tze for being an excellent and patient trainer!

Working with WenTze and her amazing team at Back to Basics was our first experience with boarding/training and we could not be happier! Our 5 month old mini bernedoodle Frankie was a bit tough to train. He needed lots of help in learning basic commands, socializing, potty training, setting a schedule and just grasping the puppy basics. From our first interaction with WenTze  - we knew we made the best decision and were in the right hands. We were kept in the loop of all Frankie's progress via text, photos and videos. It was so exciting to watch his progress! He came home with so many new skills, learned basic commands and was a different (happier, more educated) dog!  Additionally, WenTze was so helpful with offering lots of advice on all the things that can be can a bit challenging with a new pup. We will also be boarding with B2B/Posh Pets Club in the future as we know Frankie will be in THE BEST hands. This was really an exceptional experience and we are so very thankful for Back to Basics/Posh Pets Club and everyone on Frankie's team. Such an extraordinary business - We're forever grateful.

Jenn is amazing!!! In the two private sessions we had with her we noticed a change in our lab almost immediately! She is truly a puppy whisperer! Not only did she help us train our puppy but more importantly she helped train us and gave us great tools to use! Best money we’ve spent on our little puppy!

Highly recommend Back to Basics!
After four private lessons with MJ, my 3 year old dog can run off leash in areas where it is safe for her to do so. The “come” command with treats works like a charm. Before working with MJ, this would not have been possible!!!
